title: Devastator — The Capture of Tantive IV
description: A huge armoured Imperial wedge with continuous machinery trenches, eight heavy turbolaser batteries, seven recessed ion engines and twin faceted shield generators. The eleven-engine Tantive IV is suspended beneath the open ventral docking bay. Compact black cradles leave the pointed bow floating over the captured corvette.

sections.name: Connected hull ribs and interlocking decks
Curved dorsal armour and panel seams
Reactor housings, conduits and service decks
Faceted bridge and continuous observation slit
